create_measurements_registry: create a Measurements registry instance to track experiment data across named channels
publish_datum_to_channel: publish a datum to a named channel in the Measurements registry for later retrieval
get_last_datum_from_channel: get the last datum published to a specific channel in the Measurements registry
get_all_channels_snapshot: get a deep copy of all channels and their data from the Measurements registry
close_measurements_channels: close a specific channel or all channels in the Measurements registry to clean up
